# Own MP3 mono-path regression fixtures

Deterministic 0.4-second, envelope-modulated tones generated by FFmpeg/libmp3lame:

- `mpeg1.mp3`: 48 kHz, stereo, 128 kbit/s.
- `mpeg2.mp3`: 22.05 kHz, stereo, 64 kbit/s.
- `mpeg25.mp3`: 11.025 kHz, stereo, 32 kbit/s.
- `mono.mp3`: 24 kHz, mono, 32 kbit/s.

Regenerate with `tools/esp8266_audio_profile/generate_mono_fixtures.ps1`.
Encoder-version differences may change encoded bytes; regression compares
the same stored inputs through stereo and mono decoders, without requiring
an installed encoder. See `docs/ESP8266_MP3_MONO.md` for measured results.
